race.description: The Sunday Times 3yo Fillies Wa Oaks Preview Ms Pace
race.comment: IMA BOOTY SHAKER NZ (3) hasn't raced since she came from the back row and finished fourth at Listed level at Pinjarra in July. Won the only time she attempted this distance and is well served by this draw. IM CATEGORY FIVE (1) had to be used up early last time and the effort told on her late. Has the speed to be prominent from the inside draw so is worth another chance. KATAMA NZ (12) broke when resuming but has won a trial since. Won her only second-up attempt so is worth another chance. SUGA NZ (2) gets a good draw for her return and has won when fresh before so keep safe.
